data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 卫宫家餐桌
data.description: 【阿尔托莉雅 · 卫宫家餐桌】冬木市卫宫宅温馨的饭厅里，热气腾腾的寿喜烧与刚出锅的白米饭散发着诱人香气。端坐在暖桌前的骑士王两眼放光，头上呆毛欢快地晃动着，端起饭碗认真地看向你——「士郎，今天的饭菜极其美味！如果不介意的话……请务必再为我盛第三碗。」
data.action: 端坐暖桌前，期待面前冒着热气的美食
data.promptProse: Artoria sits upright at the Emiya household's wooden dining table, eagerly regarding the steaming rice bowl before her. Her dark-blue knit cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt replace the knight's armor in the eye-level medium view. Table boards lead toward the quiet room behind her. Soft morning light brightens the bowl and her expectant green eyes; warm pendant light touches her blonde hair, with steam rising through their meeting glow.
